item.title: Kiefer Sherwood Signs Big Extension With Sharks

item.title: Maple Leafs' Chris Tanev Out for Season
item.description: The Toronto Maple Leafs will be without their best defensive defenceman for the rest of this season, as Chris Tanev has undergone core muscle surgery. Tanev is expected to make a full recovery in time for training camp in September.Tanev has been out for the majority of the season with multiple injuries. item.title: Colorado Avalanche & Nashville Predators Complete Trade
item.description: The Colorado Avalanche have made a depth move on the blue line ahead of the trade deadline, acquiring defenseman Nick Blankenburg from the Nashville Predators. In return, Colorado is sending Nashville a fifth-round pick in the 2027 NHL Draft as the Western Conference powerhouse continues to fine-tune its roster for a playoff run.
